en-US.description: A Windows anime player built on mpv with AI upscaling, frame interpolation, danmaku, and Bangumi sync.
en-US.longDescription:
mpv-AnimeFusion is an anime-focused player built around mpv, combining features from many projects: AI upscaling, frame interpolation, danmaku comments, and Bangumi watch-progress sync.

- AI upscaling and frame interpolation: improve picture quality and playback smoothness.
- On-demand downloads: fetch the models and GPU components you need.
- Danmaku: online comments plus local XML, JSON, and ASS files; online danmaku is compatible with the DanDanPlay API v2, ships no comment sources, and requires your own compatible third-party API.
- Bangumi sync: automatically syncs your collection and watch progress.

zh-CN.description: Windows 动漫播放器：AI 超分与补帧、弹幕、Bangumi 观看进度同步。
zh-CN.longDescription:
mpv-AnimeFusion 是动漫专用的 mpv 融合播放器，集百家功能于一身，支持 AI 超分、补帧、弹幕和 Bangumi 观看进度同步。

- AI 超分与补帧：提升画质与播放流畅度。
- 按需下载：按需下载需要的模型和显卡组件。
- 弹幕：支持在线弹幕及本地 XML、JSON、ASS 弹幕文件；在线弹幕兼容弹弹play API v2 接口，不内置或提供任何弹幕线路，需自行添加兼容的第三方弹幕 API。
- Bangumi 同步：自动同步收藏与观看进度。
zh-CN.name: mpv-AnimeFusion
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
